title: Ivo and the Colony
author: Felix Ishikawa
blurb: Lena Okafor, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
